name: @sderickson/notebook-deploy
description: Deploy for the notebook product: its monolith and web container. Joins the platform's (deploy/) edge network and registers its routes with the edge.

scripts.prod-local: sh ../../hub/deploy/scripts/prod-local-claim-edge.sh notebook-prod-local && . ./env.remote && export CONTAINER_REGISTRY && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml up --detach --remove-orphans && (cd ../../hub/deploy && saf-deploy register-sites --local) && saf-deploy register-sites --local && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml logs --follow --since 1m $(docker compose -f docker-compose.prod-local.yaml config --services | grep -v kratos-migrate)
